review.tagline: Document parser that converts PDFs, images and Office files to Markdown and JSON
review.summary: MinerU parses PDFs, scanned images, Office, OpenDocument, EPUB, OFD, HTML and CSV files into Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, DOCX and structured content lists. It offers four parsing tiers (flash, basic, standard, advanced), a local document library with search, and page/block locators for citations. It ships a CLI, Python SDK, API, router and Gradio WebUI, plus an agent skill.
review.audience: Engineers feeding PDFs and Office documents to LLM pipelines or agents
strengths: Handles scanned PDFs, tables and formulas, with four quality tiers from fast preview to advanced
Stable doc/tier/page/block locators allow paged reading and citation of long documents
Small models run on ONNX CPU; the VLM can run on llama.cpp, vLLM or LMDeploy
Documents are not uploaded to the official service unless remote parsing is configured
weaknesses: Office, HTML, EPUB, OFD and CSV files only get flash-tier parsing; higher tiers are PDF and image only
Docker deployment for non-NVIDIA devices is pending an update
Highest throughput needs an NVIDIA GPU and mineru[full]; Windows needs torch installed separately
License is reported as NOASSERTION, so terms need checking before use
needs: Needs Python >=3.10,<3.15, llama.cpp, vLLM or LMDeploy (VLM runtime), ONNX or Torch
Models: MinerU VLM, ONNX small models, Torch small models, llama.cpp, vLLM
